in_marathi.name: Bhagat
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhagat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who possesses the Bhagya (good fortune) of God. This name is derived from the Sanskrit root 'bhaj' which means 'to serve, to adore, or to worship'. Bhagat is a revered name in Hinduism and is often used for those who have dedicated their lives to serving the divine.
